inputLayout.numeric: Float64, widening excluded as fixture setup

records.limits: Optimistic fixed-workload TS observation, not a mathematical lower bound or universal JS impossibility result. Raw bound/split read flat decoded bytes/numbers and hash every text row. Native wide consumes the original decoded dictionary segments, hashes/maps all entries and translates every row within timing, then uses packed five-AVG state. No precomputed canonical IDs/ranks. All use exact collision equality. Highcard native includes an exact full-input min/max probe and direct-address COUNT/SUM state with an exact general-hash fallback for a wide domain; highcard split and both other DISTINCT kernels alias bound (not independent algorithms). Operator keeps original scan dictionary forms and includes matching sort/top-N, copying and governor/driver/task clock. Whole is prepared pipeline/owned frames; outer harness separately measures SQL through cleanup. Feed is scan/project/discard only, not additive with the other sinks. Setup/flattening (including numeric widening to Float64) excluded; kernel allocation/state/final ordering included. Borrowed immutable inputs need no key copy; no memory governor/spill/cancellation in plain TS. AVG Sxx retained. Plain kernels are diagnostics; operator/candidate configurations are reported separately. An optional pinned main constructor controls the raw operator; its keys/states are bundled from that revision, with shared owner contracts only.

result: No accepted reverse-direction regression in all 15 plentiful-memory whole-query shapes, 1M wide whole query, or isolated 1M wide component. Point estimates can be worse; retain all pairs.
limits: Loaded host; no quiet-host or browser Gate B acceptance.
Component measures certified decoded hash and matching result ordering, not pressure fallback throughput.
Pressure restoration deliberately pays bounded sorting and I/O after eviction; no input replay or combine.
Variable-state handoff below a retaining join and unproven computed argument materialization retain the external fallback.
B1-owned shared ScratchSpillFile extent-list metadata remains uncharged; bounded operator tape metadata is not a whole-service RSS proof.
